description: Framework-neutral tool catalog for the learning service core (spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-learning-service-core-design.md, section 'Framework independence'). Every runtime adapter (Hermes, or any later framework) loads this file and registers the tools in its own way, forwarding calls to `endpoint` with the service token and the turn's bound acting identity. Adding a tool means editing this file only.

tools.name: get_next_items
tools.description: Get the acting learner's next items to review: overdue cards first, then unlocked new items, with answer keys stripped.

tools.name: submit_review
tools.description: Submit the learner's response to an item and get back the grade, correctness, and updated concept mastery.

response.description: {choice: int} for mcq, {choices: [int]} for msq, {rating: 1-4} for self_rated, {text: str} for short_answer.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: Get the acting learner's per-concept mastery, due counts, and which concepts are unlocked.

tools.name: get_due_summary
tools.description: Get due/overdue/new-available counts for the acting learner, for rendering a digest.

tools.name: get_answers
tools.description: List the acting learner's own past short-answer submissions, paginated.

tools.name: delete_answers
tools.description: Delete all of the acting learner's stored answers immediately.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: List the acting learner's own tutoring notes, newest first.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Save a short tutoring note about the acting learner (max 20 notes, 500 characters each).

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete one of the acting learner's own notes by id.

tools.name: delete_notes
tools.description: Delete all of the acting learner's own notes.

tools.name: request_link_code
tools.description: Mint a one-time, 15-minute code the acting learner can send from another platform to link that identity.

tools.name: link_identity
tools.description: Consume a link code to attach a new platform identity to the person who minted it.

tools.name: get_team_overview
tools.description: For a manager: per-concept mean mastery, share mastered, and at-risk counts, plus per-person adherence, velocity, and last active, across their subtree.

tools.name: get_team_concept
tools.description: For a manager: per-person mastery for one concept, across their subtree.

tools.name: get_team_person
tools.description: For a manager: one reportee's concept-level state and metrics.

tools.name: get_team_recommendations
tools.description: For a manager: the top concepts their subtree should focus on next, ranked, with the metrics behind the ranking.

tools.name: get_team_digest
tools.description: For a manager: the weekly digest payload for their subtree.

tools.name: set_team_focus
tools.description: For a manager: set a focus (extra weight in item selection) on a concept for their subtree or for one reportee.

tools.name: delete_team_focus
tools.description: For a manager: remove a focus they set or that scopes a subtree they own.
